title: [SCM] Post Inventory Cost to G/L: stop using marks, add clean-up for Post Value Entry to G/L
summary: Report 1002 now stops using marks to delete processed rows and instead filters by value entry numbers, adds automatic cleanup of stale rows, and introduces a new page and report for managing value entries to post to G/L.
key_points: Report 1002 collects processed entries in a temporary table and deletes by filtered ranges instead of using marks, fixing platform issues with row-by-row deletes on large datasets
Stale rows (fully posted or orphaned entries) are now automatically removed from table 5811 when posting, preventing accumulation that can block future runs
New page 5813 shows value entries to post to G/L with amounts, accessible from the Inventory Cost Adjustment overview
New report 5813 allows customers to manually clean up stale rows with a count-only option
Page 5801 Inventory Cost Adjustment replaces show/hide actions with views and hides obsolete actions
